metadata.title: greensand-nir: open Python package for green sand NIR spectral mixing, preprocessing and PLSR calibration v1.0.0
metadata.description: Tested, documented Python package: Hapke and linear mixing, water film model, InGaAs instrument and noise simulation, NIR preprocessing (absorbance, SNV, MSC, Savitzky-Golay), PLSR with cross-validation, detection-limit scoring, and the full reproducible pipeline.
